notes: Small additive creator-revision build for Toolbox Talks. TBTs created inside Safety Tracker now support Edit in app -> new version from Training details and directly from the linked RA/COSHH impact screen. The previous structured TBT content is copied into a new revision draft, the displayed document version is advanced automatically, and the Manager can edit only what changed. Generate/import creates a pending replacement TBT linked to the current one. The existing approved TBT remains live until the replacement is opened and approved; approval then archives the old TBT and transfers its audience/assignments through the existing controlled approval workflow. TBT delivery remains instructor-led for every version. External/uploaded TBTs continue to use the replacement-PDF route. Uses the creator revision columns added in v2.10.58; no new database migration is required. Refresher-method controls and ad-hoc retraining remain the next separate builds.
